text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After our outing, Narita Top Road said there was a place
she wanted to visit, and she led me to—

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
It's right over there!
That's the dance school my friend goes to!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
I heard that after taking up dance lessons,
their footwork in races improved too.
That's why I'd love to go try it.
choice_data_list: It looks like it's worth a try!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Yes, I'll do my best!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
One, two, three, four!
One, two, three!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Phew...!
How did that look, Sensei?!

text_block_list.name: Instructor
text_block_list.text:
Mmhmm.
You're doing the basic steps quite well.

text_block_list.name: Instructor
text_block_list.text:
Well then, next, shall we have them join in
on the team practice? Is that alright with all of you?

text_block_list.name: Students
text_block_list.text: Okaaay!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Thank you!
Yes, please! I'd love to!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
One, two, one, two...
Ah, I'm sorry!

text_block_list.name: Student A
text_block_list.text:
Don't worry! 
People always bump into each other a lot at first~.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much.
The next step is... whoa?!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Ugh...
It's just not going well at all...!
choice_data_list: You’ve got the Winning Live dance down, right?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Umm, live concerts have stage marks on the floor...
so it's easy to tell how much space to keep from the other girls.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Still, without a landmark, it's hard to get a feel for it.
I end up moving too far on accident...
Hi! Fancy meeting you here, Top Road!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Ah, Tap-chan. What brings you here?

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Mom knows the owner here.
She lets us use it from time to time.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
More importantly, you're looking pretty down, Top Road.
Dancing is all about letting loose!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: That is—

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
I see, you're having trouble figuring out how to dance?
Then I'll show you how it's done!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Put your passion into the sound!
Just like this!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: —...Ngh. What an incredible presence...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
It's so sparkly... It feels like
the spotlight is on me non-stop...

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"Thank you so much!
Did my passion reach you?"

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Tap-chan, your dance
was shining so brightly!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
I want to dance like Tap-chan too!
Even if I can't right now, someday for sure!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Heh, Excellent!
I eagerly await that moment.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Trainer. I'm going to work even harder on my dance practice!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Of course, training our footwork is the main objective, but—

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: “But just as much as that, I want to sparkle and shine just like Tap-chan!”

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
"I want to be an Umamusume that
everyone looks up to and can't wait to watch!"
choice_data_list: I'm sure you can do it!
I'm sure you can do it!
For that to happen, I need special training!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
"I want to be an Umamusume that
everyone looks up to and can't wait to watch!"
choice_data_list: I'm sure you can do it!
I'm sure you can do it!
For that to happen, I need special training!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Shining bright with a captivating dance.
I told Narita Top Road that
I wanted to see that version of her too.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much!
Those words are so encouraging!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: All right! I'll do my best to live up to Trainer's expectations!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Not just admiring, but striving to reach that very height. For the sake of Narita Top Road, I told her I would cooperate and do whatever I could to help.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Thank you! Hearing you say that really puts my mind at ease!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Let's give it our all in both racing and dancing,
as a three-legged team!
